payload.application_scope: Ledger item 8 only: the change of variables to the quadratic normal form, as the explicit components of the tree's own Equiv values. No coefficient module, marking, field, resolver, eta or source certificate is selected: every signature theorem is quantified over the coefficient group.
payload.hash_scope: Identity of the serialized coordinate components and the named normal-form records at the stated handle rank. It is not a hash of any proof, and it says nothing about the normal-form records' content.
payload.head_note: All four sectors share one handle regrouping, from Fin h times Fin 2 into A to Fin h into A times A, through finTwoProdAddEquiv. What differs is the head: L carries one head coordinate and leaves it alone, N0 carries two and leaves both alone, and both Npc sectors carry two and replace the first by its image under the normal-form operator Phi. Only the Npc sectors are a change of variables in the ledger item's sense; the other two are rebracketings.
payload.warning: Only the change of variables is bound here. The quadratic normal form RECORD itself, SourceOddHessian, is not: the declarations that build it take a descent datum, a factor set, a projection, a coefficient module with its topology and action, a simplicity hypothesis and a cardinality, so a rfl signature theorem against one would require selecting a coefficient module, which this lane is forbidden to do. Those records are named below with the bridge kind named_but_unbound, and naming is not binding.
